title: BillingCashoutRequest
description: billing.cashout-request@1: bodies of billing.cashout.request on OpenVibe.Billing. POST /api/v1/cashouts: { subject, amount, payout_method: { type, address } } moves amount bits (at least the minimum cashout) from the person's payable into payouts pending, in escrow until staff pay it (a PayPal address must be an email). POST /api/v1/recycle: { subject, amount } turns payable back into the person's own spendable credit. GET /api/v1/cashouts/:id takes no body. Every mutating call needs an Idempotency-Key header (a replay with the same key and body returns the first answer) and is refused with 503 billing.frozen while the economy is frozen. Refusals are problem+json (billing.invalid_input, billing.invalid_amount, billing.insufficient_funds, …).
